work.name: University of Illinois Chicago
highlights: Authored a technical proposal that secured an $80,000 Amazon Research Award (ARA) for efficient vision-language modeling.
Conducting ongoing research on efficient multimodal generation, speculative decoding, and adaptive computation for vision-language and diffusion models.
Developed CARN for complexity-aware adaptive inference. Reported up to 4× lower computational cost and over 10× lower parameter movement on evaluated vision benchmarks.
Constructed pruned task modules at different compute budgets. Trained a routing network to balance predictive performance with computational efficiency.

work.name: University of Nebraska–Lincoln
highlights: Designed energy-aware routing across compressed task modules with shared features and unified distillation. Reported 3.70% accuracy improvement on Tiny-ImageNet.
Developed EnCoDe, jointly training an adversarial sampler and feature-distilled student. Outperformed evaluated baselines using 60% of training samples.
Collaborated on APRIS hardware–software co-design, developing 5-bit quantization and weight-sharing methods. The system achieved approximately 3.48 TOPS/W in circuit-to-application co-simulation.

work.name: Redev Technology (Remote)
highlights: Developed automated labeling and model-assisted annotation workflows, reducing image annotation costs by up to 30%.
Spearheaded scalable workplace safety monitoring solutions with robust object detection across challenging lighting, weather, and occlusion conditions.

work.name: NAAMII
highlights: Developed HOG-supervised multi-task segmentation. Achieved 70.2% mIoU on robotic instrument type segmentation, 3.9 percentage points above SurgiNet.
Collaborated on federated segmentation using client encoders and a shared frozen decoder. Achieved 62.0% EndoUDA mIoU, outperforming FedAvg by 8.9 percentage points.

projects.name: PVRD: Prior-guided Visual Residual Drafting for VLM Inference (Ongoing research)
projects.summary: Developing speculative decoding that selects visual evidence beyond the language prior. The method adapts when and how much image information the drafter receives. Selected 21.3 of 576 patches on average, a 96.3% smaller budget, with 93.49% mean next-token distribution overlap in oracle experiments.

projects.name: Adaptive Modality Selection for Multimodal Diffusion (Ongoing research)
projects.summary: Investigating predictive latent representations to decide when additional modality information justifies its computational cost during multimodal generation.

projects.name: CodeAlign: Code LLM Fine-tuning for Intelligent Code Understanding
projects.summary: Fine-tuned DeepSeek-Coder-7B using QLoRA and DPO. Integrated Tree-sitter parsing, FAISS retrieval, and vLLM serving for repository-aware code explanation.

projects.name: ClauseAI: LLM-Based Contract Risk Analyzer
projects.summary: Developed a clause-level contract risk analysis platform using locally deployed Llama 3.1, RAG, and FAISS-based semantic retrieval over the CUAD dataset.

projects.name: SuperRes.AI: Real-World Image Super-Resolution with GANs
projects.summary: Built a 4× image upscaling pipeline using Real-ESRGAN and GFPGAN, with selective face restoration and compositing.

projects.name: Graduate Program Management
projects.summary: Developed a centralized academic management platform integrating student, faculty, curriculum, advising, and committee records into a unified PostgreSQL system.
